background.value: Plain light-colored background with no shadows

head_height.value: Face must take up 70–80% of the photo, measured from the top of the hairline/crown of the head to the tip of the chin.

validity.value: No more than six months old as of the date of the application, and must reflect current appearance.

file_spec.value: Digital JPEG photo required for the e-visa system.

expression_restriction.value: Full-face view; head must not be tilted or turned. Look directly at the camera with a neutral expression, mouth closed, eyes open and clearly visible.

glasses_policy.value: Eyes must be clearly visible; flash reflection off lenses and tinted lenses are not allowed.

face_visibility.value: Head centered and fully visible from hairline/crown to chin tip, nose on the symmetry line; photo must show the top of the head and top of the shoulders.

headwear_policy.value: Religious head coverings are permitted if the face is clearly visible from the bottom of the chin to the top of the forehead.

expression.en: Full-face view, head not tilted or turned; look directly at the camera with a neutral expression, mouth closed, eyes open and clearly visible.
expression.ko: 정면 얼굴 전체가 보여야 하며 고개를 기울이거나 돌리지 않을 것. 무표정으로 카메라를 정면으로 응시하고 입은 다물고 눈은 뜬 채로 뚜렷이 보여야 한다.
expression.ja: 顔全体が正面を向き、頭を傾けたり回したりしないこと。無表情でカメラを直視し、口を閉じ、目を開けてはっきり見えるようにすること。

glasses.en: Eyes must be clearly visible; flash reflection off lenses and tinted lenses are not allowed.
glasses.ko: 눈이 뚜렷이 보여야 하며, 렌즈에 플래시 반사나 색이 들어간 렌즈는 허용되지 않는다.
glasses.ja: 目がはっきり見える必要があり、レンズへのフラッシュ反射や色付きレンズは認められない。

face_visibility.en: Head must be centered and fully visible from hairline/crown to chin tip, with the nose on the symmetry line.
face_visibility.ko: 머리는 정중앙에 위치하고 헤어라인(정수리)부터 턱끝까지 완전히 보여야 하며, 코는 대칭선 위에 있어야 한다.
face_visibility.ja: 頭は中央に位置し、生え際(頭頂部)から顎先まで完全に見える必要があり、鼻は対称線上にあること。

headwear.en: Religious head coverings are permitted if the face is clearly visible from the bottom of the chin to the top of the forehead.
headwear.ko: 종교적 머리가리개는 턱 아래부터 이마 위까지 얼굴이 뚜렷이 보이는 경우 허용된다.
headwear.ja: 宗教上の頭部covering(スカーフ等)は、顎の下から額の上まで顔がはっきり見える場合に限り許可される。

db_conflicts.research_value: No absolute cm/mm figure is published — specified only as a proportion (face = 70–80% of the photo, measured from hairline/crown to chin tip).

cross_verification.note_en: evisa.kdmid.ru is the official Consular Department of the Russian MFA e-visa portal, content read directly. Size (35×45mm) matches DB exactly — no conflict. DB's 'light gray' background is broadly consistent with the source's 'plain light-colored background' wording, though the source does not name the specific hue 'gray' explicitly, so this is treated as consistent rather than as an independently confirmed exact match.
